title: ServiceNow incident Lambda for the help desk flow
scenario: LFG's inbound flow calls a Lambda that identifies the caller through Customer Profiles, counts their open ServiceNow incidents and opens one for the call. The contractor's version minted a token per call, saw only the first page of incidents, threw on 429 at the Monday peak and opened duplicate incidents when Connect retried. Make it production grade against a local fake ServiceNow.
task: Customer Profiles SearchProfiles on _phone, with NOT_FOUND and AMBIGUOUS paths
ServiceNow sys_user and incident reads with sysparm_query/sysparm_fields and Link pagination
Create the incident once per contact (correlation_id = ContactId lookup-before-create)
OAuth client credentials with token caching, early refresh and 401 refresh
429 Retry-After within a 6.5 s budget; DEGRADED flat map instead of throwing
acceptance: Every outcome returns a flat STRING_MAP
Exactly one incident per contact across retries, even when the match is on the last page
One token across warm invocations; refreshed near expiry and after 401
Waits honor Retry-After, stay under budget, bounded retries
